result.reason: The operative language includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and conditional cyber limits and requires certificates on request, but omits workers’ compensation insurance as required by law, which remains required even under the fallback. It also adds an unsupported one-year post-Term insurance obligation, so the revision is not minimal. The existing force-majeure provision is preserved, although “Customer data” should match the defined-term capitalization “Customer Data.”
